page.layout: One scanned image of a book cover (binding), not a printed page: the front board with a marbled red-and-cream paper, brown leather corners, and the spine at left with raised bands and a small gold-tooled black label. No printed text on the page.
page.notes: Photograph of the binding only: marbled paper boards, leather corners and spine with raised bands and a gold-tooled label. The label carries no legible printed text on this scan. A small white paper scrap is visible at the lower left edge of the spine. No printed text to transcribe.
